title: Quietly Pungent Russian Shallots Pasta
description: A pungent and fluffy solo dinner dish featuring shallots and a pasta water emulsion, friendly to low glycemic diets. This Russian inspired dish is perfect for a quiet night in.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining the spaghetti.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium low heat and cook the sliced shallots for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet with the shallots and toss to combine.
Add the reserved pasta water to the skillet in small increments and continue to toss until the pasta is well coated and the sauce has reached the desired consistency.
Season the pasta with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with grated grana padano cheese.
Garnish with chopped fresh dill if desired.
